response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate is overqualified and lacks relevant Java focus, agile project exposure in insurance contexts, and sufficient German language proficiency — all critical for this junior role targeting entry-level candidates in a German-speaking consulting environment.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical leadership in diverse projects
Demonstrated expertise in testing, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices
concerns: Primary experience is in TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, not Java as required
German language skill is only 'basic', insufficient for client-facing consulting work
Senior-level titles and 10+ years of experience make this a severe overqualification for an entry-level role
